title: Admin Command Hub for Chained Ops Recipes
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Oncall and support engineers repeatedly assemble ad-hoc shell fragments, ad-hoc API calls, and manual dashboard lookups to resolve incidents. We have multiple one-off admin utilities and half-baked scripts in Drive/Git; they are brittle, hard to audit, and often aren't idempotent. Goal: deliver an "Admin Command Hub" — a composable, auditable, RBAC-governed service that exposes small, typed operational primitives (commands) which can be chained into parameterized ops recipes. The Hub should power both the Console UI (one-click remediation flows), an internal CLI, and an API for automated runbooks-as-tasks invoked by support automation workflows. Key properties: idempotency, dry-run/simulate mode, explicit safety gates, centralized telemetry and cost accounting per remediation, automatic audit logging (immutable), and traceable rollouts for new commands/recipe versions.
acceptance_criteria: Provide a catalog UI in Console with searchable commands and example recipes
Commands are defined with JSON schema for inputs and outputs and are validated at runtime
Support dry-run mode that executes validation and collects a simulated timeline without making destructive changes
All executions produce immutable audit records (who/what/when/inputs/outputs) stored in central audit store
RBAC enforces who can view, run, and publish commands/recipes; console actions respect team-level scoping
Recipe chaining supports sequential and conditional steps, with explicit rollback hooks for each step
End-to-end test harness that can replay a recipe in a sandbox environment, with recorded telemetry
Integration with existing incident automation: can be invoked by incident runbooks and by autonomous remediators with throttling
Telemetry surfaced in Dashboard: success rate, median execution latency, cost per run, and mean time saved per remediation
implementation_plan: MVP schema: command definition model + execution engine (stateless controller)
Build admin command registry service with API and Postgres backing store
Add console catalog view and CLI wrapper with login/RBAC enforcement
Implement dry-run simulator and immutable audit exporter to existing audit-log pipeline
Create recipe DSL limited to sequential and guarded conditional steps (no arbitrary code execution for MVP)
Add step rollback hooks and execution timeouts; surface failures in console and incident timelines
Integrate telemetry events into telemetry pipeline and dashboard panels
Security review & threat modelling before internal pilot; create gating checklist
rollback_plan: If a release causes regressions we will: 1) disable new recipe publishing via a feature flag, 2) revert the registry schema migration to previous read-only mode (no new command creations), 3) switch on a global safety hold that automatically aborts executions from the Hub and routes callers to a read-only simulated mode, 4) run a postmortem and if needed rollback service to prior deployment. All rollback steps are automated as part of the deploy pipeline and listed in the runbook linked in artifacts.
